study.question: Does the latest task-private event-rank route help because it resolves complementary feedback identities, or because it duplicates an existing collapsed positional function with a different optimization path? Observed full-validation click AUC: baseline-din 0.6555440824200336; g3-r0015-position_task_primary 0.6655420609167614; r0018 event/readout 0.6655357893063016, marginal/readout 0.6655115001798914, event/route 0.6661698163351560 and marginal/route 0.6658004456369023. The route-versus-readout event difference is +0.0006340270; event-versus-marginal within routing is +0.0003693707. Earlier r0014 position resolved/collapsed AUCs 0.6655022335039306/0.6655081613932129 provide counterevidence to assuming feedback identity always helps. All are validation observations at the frozen single seed, not repeated support. New source inspection shows that the old collapsed position correction lies in the linear span of the new resolved OR collapsed event-rank correction, before the same downstream donor/tanh/mass-preserving gate. This motivates replacement controls rather than repeating only the existing marginal/readout contrasts.
study.hypothesis: Provisional mechanism: retaining feedback identity in a task-private event-rank correction permits useful task-conditioned redistribution beyond aggregate historical feedback intensity; the gain should survive removing the overlapping primary-owned collapsed positional route. This is not established: r0014 identity was nearly null, and r0018 may instead benefit from redundant primary parameterization or indirect auxiliary coupling. The study crosses identity with retention of the old positional correction. It does not introduce a new unified architecture or establish a novel method. Information audit: only contracted user/context/item fields, masked histories, four overlapping historical feedback masks and valid-event ranks are used. Ranks count valid exposures to the right, not elapsed time. No current target action/label, timestamps, future events or sample IDs are used. Auxiliary labels concern user/category/brand matches over 24 hours, not advertisement-level conversion. The official_offline visibility assumption remains fixed; point-in-time production validity is not inferred.

study.proposed_difference: Two architecture booleans and no new parameters: rank_feedback_identity selects original channels or replaces four feedback slots by their mean only within _rank_evidence_logits; exposure and the sum of possibly overlapping feedback slots are preserved. retain_position_route multiplies the already-computed old _position_gate_logits output by1 or0 before adding the task-private rank route. This retains its original primary-only gradient boundary in duplicate cells; single cells give it a zero derivative, while all other parameters retain their inherited training paths. Both channel tensors and both routes are computed in every cell; event alignment and route placement are fixed. The initial forward functions coincide because both positional tensors start at zero. Replacement algebra: view tensors as W[task,channel,match,kernel]. With old collapsed tensor P, its forward contribution can be absorbed into the new tensor by adding P[:,0,:,:] to exposure and mean(P[:,1:,:,:],channel) to each of the four feedback rows. This works for resolved and collapsed new features. No checkpoint rewriting is performed; all runs start from scratch. Thus retaining/removing the old route changes redundant parameterization and optimization, not primary forward function space. Feedback collapse reduces a branch feature span and changes gradients; it cannot by itself prove semantic complementarity at matched effective capacity. This is an attribution/replacement study, with identity and parameterization effects to be reported separately from predictive quality and any external prior-work difference.
predictions: Host fixed-state checks: resolved/duplicate must match the parent predictions and gradients; all four cells must match at inherited zero initialization under arbitrary task order. After applying the stated synthetic nonzero-weight merge map, duplicate/single route logits must match before and after the unchanged donor/tanh/gating transformations, within declared precision tolerance. This establishes function-space inclusion only.

If feedback identity is useful beyond duplication, resolved minus collapsed click AUC should be positive in both duplicate and single cells. Predeclared practical scale:0.0001 AUC. Differences at or below that scale are inconclusive at one seed; do not claim statistical equivalence or significance.

If the useful correction survives replacement, rank_resolved_single should be within0.0001 AUC of the contemporaneous resolved/duplicate replay and exceed the older g3-r0015-position_task_primary reference. A small quality loss is not offset by claimed efficiency: this matched-compute implementation deliberately keeps both paths; production pruning would require a separate measured experiment.

Estimate identity effects I_duplicate=A(resolved,duplicate)-A(collapsed,duplicate), I_single=A(resolved,single)-A(collapsed,single), replacement effects within each identity, and interaction I_duplicate-I_single. A large duplication effect or interaction points to optimization-dependent benefit rather than an independently identified feedback mechanism.

Secondary assessment reports all four task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean AUC separately, allocated/embedding/dense counts, train/GPU/wall seconds, peak memory, throughput and p50/p95 latency. Use the four existing history bins with samples/positives/negatives and mark empty-history AUC with427 positives as weak exploratory evidence. Missing hour/frequency/behavior-composition/unseen-field diagnostics are unavailable unless the authorized host exposes them; do not invent them.
falsifiers: Resolved/single loses more than0.0001 AUC against a successfully reproduced resolved/duplicate control, especially if the latter alone retains the r0018 gain: reject the claim that the gain survives removal of redundant positional parameterization.

Collapsed cells match or exceed their resolved counterparts at this seed: no controlled support for feedback identity in this branch. Record the null/negative result and retain the simpler viable alternative provisionally; one seed cannot prove equivalence.
Any advantage is limited to the duplicated model or reverses with the replacement: feedback-identity/parameterization interaction remains the finding, not general feedback complementarity.

Mismatch of parent replay or of synthetic merge-map forward checks, masking/current-action invariance, arbitrary task-order primary selection, zero-length/all-empty behavior, expected gradients, finite BF16 outputs or the frozen ownership boundary blocks scientific interpretation. Record execution failure separately from a negative hypothesis result; no silent protocol repair.

Auxiliary AUC reductions, unchanged frozen slices, excessive measured cost, or inconsistent paired-seed follow-ups constrain scope and model selection even when click improves. Withheld outcomes cannot be used for this decision.
alternative_explanations: The old and new primary collapsed directions are redundant, yet two AdamW parameterizations alter effective step sizes, weight decay, dense global clipping and tanh saturation. Matching function spaces is not matching training trajectories.

Resolved branch nominal feature span is at most80/task versus32/task after collapse; auxiliary private rank rows all learn, whereas old auxiliary position rows remain zero at scratch initialization because their gradients are blocked. Capacity, gradient scaling and auxiliary adaptation can all contribute.

Only new rank features change identity; the original score action values, additive evidence and event gate still distinguish feedback in all cells. A null result concerns this extra rank branch, not feedback identity throughout the whole model.

Task-private rank rows have no direct cross-task parameter sharing, but auxiliary changes can affect click through shared context and dense clipping. This suite does not isolate those indirect paths. A justified next experiment would stop only new auxiliary rank gradients while retaining their forward values.

Positive observation: r0018 event routing beat readout/marginal controls in one seed. Null/counterevidence: r0014 positional identity had near-zero effect. Unsuccessful mechanisms: g3-r0006-learned_aux_transfer AUC0.659257496484386 versus its earlier private-auxiliary parent0.6601638277860222; g3-r0017-position_gradient_project0.6641686829139023 remained below its primary-only control0.665517949606882. These were successful executions with negative mechanism results, not missing data or runtime failures, and do not refute untested auxiliary mechanisms.

Repeated validation-guided selection across the lineage and one fixed seed can explain small gains. Replaying the same seed is a reproducibility control, not independent mechanism evidence. No user-cluster prediction archive or bootstrap interface is exposed here; report interval unavailability rather than fabricate confidence.

Public auxiliary labels are rare and do not attribute advertisement-specific conversions. Released offline history may contain feedback not yet mature in production. Neither a gain nor a null here establishes online causality or general transfer.
